history.text: The Swazi nation consolidated under Ngwane III north of the Pongola.
Britain took administration after the South African War.
Independence came on 6 September under King Sobhuza II.
Political parties were banned and rule by decree introduced.
The country was renamed from Swaziland to Eswatini.

worthSeeing.title: Mlilwane Wildlife Sanctuary:
worthSeeing.text: The country's first protected area, in the Ezulwini valley.

worthSeeing.title: Umhlanga reed dance:
worthSeeing.text: An annual ceremony drawing tens of thousands of participants.

worthSeeing.title: Malolotja Nature Reserve:
worthSeeing.text: Highland grassland with waterfalls and the Ngwenya iron mine nearby.
